h: Mother and child reportedly die as two container trucks overturn in Lagos
p: A mother and her child have reportedly died after two container trucks overturned at Mile 2 in Apapa, Lagos. Emergency responders are said to have been called to the scene. The cause of the accident has not been confirmed.
more: Heavy container traffic around the Apapa corridor has long been a safety concern.
Further details from the authorities are awaited.
